title: Algebraic Bifurcation Dynamics of Fronto-Parietal Theta Oscillations Account for Phase-Specific Modulation of Human Episodic Sequence Memory
description: Reproducibility package containing Weierstrass-Kuramoto algebraic-geometric solvers, Bernstein-Kushnirenko-Khovanskii (BKK) mixed-volume calculators, polynomial homotopy continuation inverse-control scripts, 68-region human structural connectome (dk68) stochastic simulations, empirical re-analysis of N=42 human fronto-parietal theta tACS sessions (8,032 TOJ trials from OSF 4xwkj), publication figures, and manuscript build scripts.
